Solution · The engine inside

Mantha

What is Mantha? The AI that reads your room like a decorator.

Mantha looks at your photo the way a designer would: it finds the walls, the floor, the direction of the light and where the shadows fall. Then it changes only the surfaces you choose.

Your sofa stays your sofa. The window light stays where it was. What changes is the paint, the paper or the boards underfoot, drawn in the right perspective so it looks like it was always there.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a special camera?

No. Any recent phone camera works. Stand in a corner, hold the phone level, and get two walls and some floor in the shot. Mantha handles the rest.

Will the colour on screen match the tin?

Very closely. Mantha keeps the light already in your room, so a colour looks the way it will at that time of day. Screens vary, so we always suggest a sample pot before you commit to a full room.

What does 69p include?

One room photo with unlimited paint previews on it, saved to your folder. It's our early-bird price for your first room.

Can I use it for client projects?

Yes. The Max plan adds client sharing, so you can send a preview link and your client sees exactly what you see.

What happens to my photos?

Your photos are used only to make your previews. You can delete any photo, and its previews, from your Saved folder at any time. The full details are in our privacy policy.

The ThinkDecor story

Décor shouldn't be a guess.

Every year people repaint rooms they only just painted, peel off wallpaper they only just hung, and return furniture that looked right in the shop. ThinkDecor exists so you can see the room first, and then buy.

Restyle a room for 69p →How Mantha works
The problem

Five ways décor goes wrong

None of them are about taste. They're all about not being able to see the result in your own room before you commit.

  • The tin lies

    Colour cards are lit by shop lights. Your wall gets your window, your bulbs and your north-facing gloom, so the shade you loved in the store turns flat or garish at home.

    What it costs you · Repainting, twice

  • Wallpaper is a one-way door

    Once it's pasted, a wrong pattern costs you the rolls, the paste and a weekend of steaming it back off. Samples the size of a postcard can't show a whole wall.

    What it costs you · Rolls, paste and a weekend

  • Mood boards aren't your room

    Pinterest rooms have taller ceilings, bigger windows and furniture you don't own. They sell a feeling, not a decision about your walls.

    What it costs you · Buying for someone else's house

  • Pricing a room means twenty tabs

    You see a sofa you like, then hunt through retailers to find what it costs and whether it fits. The budget is a guess until the receipts arrive.

    What it costs you · Blown budgets

  • Renters can't experiment

    No sample patches, no test boards, no second chances with the deposit on the line. Most renters simply never try.

    What it costs you · Rooms that never change
The solution

How Mantha sees your room

Mantha is the AI engine inside ThinkDecor. It reads a photo the way a decorator walks into a room: walls first, then depth, then the lines of the space, then the light.

  1. Finds every wall

    Mantha outlines each wall, floor and ceiling in your photo and keeps furniture, plants and people out of the mask.

  2. Reads the depth

    It estimates how far every part of the room is from the camera, so a wall in shadow at the back is treated differently from one near the window.

  3. Follows your room's lines

    It traces the vanishing lines of your room, so stripes, tiles and floorboards run at the same angle your walls do.

  4. Keeps your light

    The new finish takes on your room's own light and shadow, so the preview looks like a photo, not a sticker.

Why ThinkDecor

Why we're the best at this

Plenty of apps can make a pretty picture of a room. We built ThinkDecor to make an honest one: your walls, your light, your furniture, with real prices attached.

  • One photo. That's it.

    No 3D scan, no measuring tape, no special camera. A normal phone photo from the corner of the room is all Mantha needs.

  • Your furniture stays put

    We change only the surfaces you choose. Your sofa, your rug and your clutter stay exactly where they are.

  • Paint, paper and floor together

    See a new wall colour, a wallpaper and a floor in the same preview, because rooms are decided as a whole.

  • Perspective that holds up

    Patterns follow each wall's angle and corner, which is where most AI room tools give themselves away.

  • A price on everything

    Tap any piece in the frame to see what it is and what it costs, so the budget is known before anything is bought.

  • Saved, sorted, shareable

    Every preview drops into your Saved folder automatically, ready to send to a partner, a landlord or a client.
